cause: Context Pack was frozen before development started.
impact: The line has an evidence-bound starting context.
lesson: Freeze the initial context before changing implementation state.

cause: Remediation-2 adversarial probes reproduced a plain callback write bypass, incomplete post-admission snapshot validation, path-like model-run acceptance until filesystem lookup, legacy OLS helper execution outside an admitted family workflow, and restart refusal without a stable authority reason code.
impact: Workflow execution still has callback, lineage, and restart authority gaps that can allow an untrusted caller to reach a write-capable path or misclassify a refusal.
lesson: Admission must seal and revalidate the complete execution snapshot, completion must prove registered project-owned artifacts, and every compatibility route must fail closed without a durable authority proof.

cause: The first formal verification attempt used the unsupported devline_control status subcommand; the CLI rejected it before any verification or repository mutation.
impact: No implementation or formal event state was changed; verification had to be rerun with the supported verify subcommand.
lesson: Use the devline control CLI help surface and record command failures before retrying the supported formal gate.

cause: Remediation-3 local workflow truth implementation and adversarial evidence gates completed within the frozen owned scope.
impact: The scoped workflow callback, admission, completion artifact, model branch, legacy boundary, worker authority, and path-lock checks are locally verified; external product and release boundaries remain unverified.
lesson: Keep local correctness evidence separate from shared cutover, provider, browser, full-gate, and release acceptance.

cause: The remediation-2 workflow truth failure was re-exercised with red tests and closed by the receipt, artifact, model-path, restart-authority, and legacy-route fixes in this line.
impact: The scoped workflow truth failure no longer reproduces in the focused and adversarial probes; out-of-scope product and release gates remain separate.
lesson: Resolve an append-only failure through a linked review event rather than mutating its historical record.

cause: All remediation-3 required outcomes, focused tests, adversarial process/path/restart probes, formal verification, handoff, and retrospective are recorded for the owned scope.
impact: The remediation-3 development line is complete for its frozen scope; shared cutover, Notebook migration, provider, browser, full-gate, and release acceptance remain NOT VERIFIED.
lesson: A completed development line must preserve explicit limits instead of implying product release readiness.
